name: archive_probe
description: Say whether an archive or a document is password protected, with which scheme, and — the part that decides a case — whether the file names are readable without the password.

path.description: A ZIP, 7-Zip, RAR, PDF or OLE document

limit.description: Entries (or 7-Zip header strings) shown inline (default 200); all of them are counted, and when there are more the whole list is written as JSON Lines and named in all_results
